newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KRUSZWICA SHARES SOLD AT PLN 25.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KRUSZWICA SHARES SOLD AT PLN 25.

text.p: Poland's state treasury sold 1.27 million of the 1.65 million offered shares of edible fats maker Kruszwica SA at the minimum price of 25 zlotys per share, at a special bourse session, the bourse deputy president said.
"The state treasury sold 1,265,580 shares of Kruszwica at 25 zlotys, investors placed 14,093 orders and turnover amounted to 63.3 million zlotys," Piotr Szeliga told Reuters on Monday.
Investors could register for the shares, which amounted to 25 percent of the company's equity, from December 9 to 20.
The firm, to be listed on the main market of the Warsaw stock exchange, will start regular bourse trade on January 6.
